name: list_workspaces
title: List Workspaces
description: List the Workspaces this Agent connection may act in, with current member access and each Workspace's Agent identity.

name: list_projects
title: List Projects
description: List or search the Projects in this Workspace, including visibility and the authorizing member's effective access.

name: get_project
title: Get Project
description: Read one Project's title, overview, and current state.

name: get_project_context
title: Get Project Context
description: Load one bounded Project context when entering, switching, or resuming a Project or Thread: brief, member authority, relevant memory, domain-aware File summaries, recent Threads, decisions, Triggers, available actions, and revision/provenance metadata. Pass threadId when focusing a Thread; read the relevant File separately for complete resource data.

name: list_activity
title: List Activity
description: Read the authorizing member's Activity: the newest Project messages and Threads waiting on them across the Workspace.

name: list_activity_threads
title: List Activity Threads
description: Read Activity grouped by Thread, so a reply can continue the right conversation.

name: mark_activity_read
title: Mark Activity Read
description: Mark one Project Thread from Activity as read for the authorizing member.

name: list_threads
title: List Threads
description: List a Project's Threads with their task state and recent activity, newest first.

name: read_thread
title: Read Thread
description: Read one Thread: its messages, working state, delegated work, and anything waiting on a decision.

name: wait_for_thread_response
title: Wait For Thread Response
description: Poll a Project Thread that already has internal Agent work in progress. This tool does not schedule work: external start_thread and reply_in_thread calls are durable Agent-authored context writes and normally settle immediately. Keep inputSequence fixed for the internal input being followed and advance only afterSequence to the returned latestSequence.

name: list_thread_decisions
title: List Thread Decisions
description: List the questions, confirmations, and operation approvals a Thread is waiting on.

name: list_project_members
title: List Project Members
description: List who belongs to a Project and the role each one holds.

name: list_project_files
title: List Project Files
description: List the Tables, Lists, Workflows, Listenings, and Campaigns in a Project's File catalog. Use read_project_file with one returned kind and id before reasoning about that File's contents.

name: read_project_file
title: Read Project File
description: Read one bounded snapshot of a File returned by list_project_files. Tables and Lists include one paginated data page; Workflows, Listenings, and Campaigns return their current configuration. This never changes the File.

name: list_project_triggers
title: List Project Triggers
description: List a Project's Triggers: the conditions and schedules that return the Agent to it.

name: start_thread
title: Start Thread
description: Commit an Agent-authored message to an existing Project by starting a durable Thread. Use this for useful work or context that belongs in SignalSurf; do not copy the host's private transcript.

name: reply_in_thread
title: Reply In Thread
description: Commit an Agent-authored reply to an existing Project Thread. Use it to add a useful result, decision, question, or evidence; do not mirror routine host chatter.

name: publish_project_conclusion
title: Publish Project Conclusion
description: Write the distilled conclusion of a project-relevant external conversation back to a Project Thread. Call this before your final answer when the discussion produced a durable decision, direction, research summary, assumption, or next step. Append to the relevant thread when known; otherwise create a new conclusion thread. Save only the useful conclusion and evidence, never the private transcript or routine tool chatter.

name: create_project
title: Create Project
description: Create a Project directly: a new area of work with its own Channel. Configure it with the other Project settings; posting a message is not how a Project is made here.

name: rename_project
title: Rename Project
description: Rename a Project when its overall goal changes.

name: list_objects
title: List Objects
description: List first-class CRM Records collections in this Workspace.

query.description: Optional name filter. Omit to list every Records collection; a product normally has only a handful.

name: get_object
title: Get Object
description: Read one CRM Records collection and its typed identity-aware schema.

name: create_object
title: Create Object
description: Create a first-class CRM Records collection.

fields.description: The Records collection's columns. Exactly one must carry is_unique: true.

primaryField.description: Field key shown as the row title. Defaults to the identity field.

name: update_object_metadata
title: Update Object Metadata
description: Update CRM Records collection metadata.

name: update_object_schema
title: Update Object Schema
description: Update a CRM Records collection schema while preserving identity rules.

fields.description: The complete intended field list, including the unchanged identity column.

name: describe_object_templates
title: Describe Object Templates
description: Describe maintained CRM Records collection templates.

resourceType.description: Which catalog to read. Defaults to Records collection templates; pass 'list' for the List templates that hang off an existing canonical Records collection.

name: search_object_templates
title: Search Object Templates
description: Search maintained CRM Records collection templates.

name: apply_object_template
title: Apply Object Template
description: Apply a maintained template to a CRM Records collection.

name: list_object_import_candidates
title: List Object Import Candidates
description: Inspect bounded Table sources that can be imported through the Record Resolver.

name: list_records
title: List Records
description: List live identity-resolved Records in a CRM Records collection.

filters.description: Field conditions, ANDed. Use has_value / is_empty for presence, contains for substring.

name: search_records
title: Search Records
description: Search live identity-resolved CRM Records.

name: get_record
title: Get Record
description: Read one live CRM Record with its typed values and provenance-safe identity.

name: get_record_field_history
title: Get Record Field History
description: Read bounded change history for one CRM Record field when audit detail is needed.

field.description: Field key to filter to. Omit for every field change.

name: create_record
title: Create Record
description: Create or converge CRM Records through the canonical Record Resolver; never blind-insert duplicates.

data.description: One Record's schema-keyed fields. Must include the Records collection's identity field — get_object returns which one that is.

records.description: Several Records at once, each the same shape as `data`. Use this instead of one call per Record.

source.description: Existing Table rows to save as canonical People/Companies Records without copying row values through model context.

selection.description: Opaque Table selection from the UI or create_selection. Pass it unchanged; the server verifies its owner, product, expiry, and source Table.

rowIds.description: Compatibility scope for source row ids already supplied by the caller. Never list rows merely to reconstruct these ids.

all.description: Explicitly import every current row in the source Table. Whole-Table import is never inferred from an omitted scope.

mappings.description: Optional Table column -> canonical Record field overrides. Omit when the Company/People mapping is deterministic from the schemas.

runId.description: Continue the same bounded Table import after create_record reported remaining rows. Pass the returned runId with objectId and no data, records, or source.

sourceTableId.description: Source Table id returned with a runId continuation. Required with runId so Project scope can authorize the persisted import source.

name: update_record
title: Update Record
description: Patch one or more CRM Records through canonical provenance and identity guards.

recordIds.description: Records that all receive the same `data` patch.

data.description: Schema-keyed fields to set. Omitted fields are untouched.

updates.description: Per-Record patches, for when each Record receives different values.

name: archive_record
title: Archive Record
description: Archive CRM Records reversibly so they leave live reads and Lists.

name: list_lists
title: List Lists
description: List saved CRM audiences and their backing Records collections.

name: get_list
title: Get List
description: Read one saved CRM audience and its membership mode.

name: list_list_records
title: List List Records
description: Read bounded live members of one CRM List.

includeRemoved.description: Explicit Lists only: also return removed memberships.

sort.description: Explicit Lists: sort by membership added time or numeric List ICP score, descending.

name: create_list
title: Create List
description: Create an Explicit or Dynamic CRM List over one Records collection.

name: update_dynamic_list
title: Update Dynamic List
description: Update a Dynamic List's saved live query.

expectedListUpdatedAt.description: Current listUpdatedAt revision returned by get_list.

name: rename_list
title: Rename List
description: Rename a CRM List.

name: add_list_entries
title: Add List Entries
description: Add existing Records to an Explicit CRM List.

selection.description: Short-lived opaque selection token from the Sheet UI or create_selection. Pass it unchanged.

data.description: Optional List-only field values applied to every added Record.

name: remove_list_entry
title: Remove List Entry
description: Remove one active membership from an Explicit CRM List.

name: restore_list_entry
title: Restore List Entry
description: Restore one previously removed Explicit List membership.

name: update_list_entry
title: Update List Entry
description: Update one List-owned membership field without changing the underlying CRM Record.

fieldKey.description: A List-only field key from get_list's columns.

name: update_list_entry_schema
title: Update List Entry Schema
description: Update the List-owned membership field schema.

expectedListUpdatedAt.description: Current listUpdatedAt revision returned by get_list.

expectedEntrySchemaUpdatedAt.description: Current entrySchemaUpdatedAt revision returned by get_list.

name: promote_dynamic_list_records
title: Promote Dynamic List Records
description: Copy selected Dynamic List Records into an Explicit List without materializing the Dynamic List.

name: get_list_qualification
title: Get List Qualification
description: Read the List-owned ICP qualification rubric and revision.

listId.description: People List whose audience criteria apply.

name: configure_list_qualification
title: Configure List Qualification
description: Update one Explicit People List's shared ICP qualification rubric with revision checks.

listId.description: People List whose audience criteria apply.

enabled.description: Whether ICP scoring is enabled; omitted means enabled. Disabling preserves criteria and existing scores.

criteria.description: Saved audience criteria for assessing collected people; an empty string disables scoring.

source.description: Whether the saved criteria were imported from the workspace or customized for this List.

workspaceMemoryId.description: Canonical workspace ICP memory ID when these criteria were imported.

workspaceMemoryVersion.description: Version of the workspace ICP at import time; later workspace edits do not change the saved criteria.

config.description: Saved audience criteria shared by this List and its Engagers.

expectedRevision.description: Current criteria revision returned by get_list_qualification; rejects stale changes.

name: assess_list_person
title: Assess List Person
description: Assess one active People List member using the saved rubric without paid lookup.

listId.description: People List whose audience criteria apply.

listEntryId.description: Active membership ID in this List; not the Person record ID.

expectedRevision.description: Current criteria revision returned by get_list_qualification; rejects stale changes.

name: configure_list_people_source
title: Configure List People Source
description: Configure or pause a guarded Warmly or RB2B source for an Explicit People List.

name: list_listenings
title: List Listenings
description: List first-class Listenings across readable Projects, or within one projectId. Returns Listening ids, names, Project placement, status, platforms, and reply-strategy readiness; no implementation Table discovery is required.

projectId.description: Optional Project scope. Omit to list Listenings across Projects whose resources/settings this member may read.

name: get_listening
title: Get Listening
description: Read one authorized Listening's complete editable settings, sources, filters, tags, reply strategies, defaults, and optional collection readiness. Missing readiness evidence is unknown, never proof that an account is disconnected.

includeCollectionReadiness.description: Include current connected-account readiness and bounded post-age counts; no crawl or paid call.

name: create_listening
title: Create Listening
description: Create a first-class Listening inside an authorized Project using SignalSurf's native source, filtering, tagging, and reply-strategy contract. Sources begin paused; enable free sources with update_listening and paid recurring collection with activate_listening.

listeningVolume.description: Explicit daily delivery settings shared by all sources in this Listening: newly retained Posts and newly delivered canonical Engagers. Uses UTC days. These are quantity settings, not provider capacity, guaranteed yield or a monetary cap. Set Posts and Engagers independently: supply at least one value, only with values the user chose. For Posts, 0 explicitly removes the daily limit. Updates merge supplied values and preserve an omitted sibling. Omit the entire policy to preserve saved limits or legacy absence. No automatic defaults.

maxPostsPerDay.description: Maximum new retained Posts per UTC day. Set 0 to remove the daily Posts limit; omit to preserve the existing setting.

maxEngagersPerDay.description: Maximum unique new people delivered to a List per UTC day for this Listening; omitted preserves its existing cap.

name.description: What this Listening is called in the sidebar, e.g. "Competitor mentions".

signals.description: Signals this Listening collects. Use this field. Each endpointId may appear once; different endpoint ids from the same platform may coexist.

endpointId.description: Exact Listening source type. A platform can have multiple Signals, such as x-post-search and x-user-posts.

inputs.description: Complete inputs for this Signal: search phrases for keyword sources, or account/profile/calendar identifiers for tracked sources. LinkedIn supports at most 5. For keyword sources, write short phrases people actually post, not ad keywords or a long concatenation of location and intent. Use the user's language and platform vocabulary. Keep account/profile identifiers unchanged for tracked-account sources. Keyword and tracked-account sources can coexist on the same platform: their results are combined, not intersected. A tracked account's posts do not implicitly have to match the keyword source. Use the Listening's Include/Exclude criteria when the user wants a content condition applied to every source.

schedule.description: Hourly, every 6 or 12 hours, or daily collection. New LinkedIn person/company sources default daily; LinkedIn keywords default every 12 hours; other sources default every 6 hours. Omit on update to preserve the saved schedule.

enabled.description: Whether this Signal collects now. New Signals default off. Paid Signals remain off until activate_listening is approved.

placeId.description: Required only for luma-event-search; the Luma location id.

platforms.description: Legacy social keyword format. Use signals for new calls; do not combine both fields.

platform.description: Supported platforms. LinkedIn accepts 1–5 inputs. Paid sources require activate_listening after saving.

keywords.description: For keyword sources, write short phrases people actually post, not ad keywords or a long concatenation of location and intent. Use the user's language and platform vocabulary. Keep account/profile identifiers unchanged for tracked-account sources. Keyword and tracked-account sources can coexist on the same platform: their results are combined, not intersected. A tracked account's posts do not implicitly have to match the keyword source. Use the Listening's Include/Exclude criteria when the user wants a content condition applied to every source.

schedule.description: How often to collect: hourly, every 6 hours (default), or once a day.

include.description: Post-content criteria: what a collected post must discuss, describe, or demonstrate to be kept. Describe observable topics, questions, experiences, or needs in the post, not the user's overall project brief. Account identity, platform, and collection schedule belong in signals; collecting commenters/reactors/reposters belongs in Engager rules; downstream outreach or reply goals are not content filters. For an account already selected in signals, describe which of its posts the user wants to see. If the user wants every post, set filterMode=bypass and omit include/exclude. Do not invent a narrower topic or infer buying intent from an outreach goal.

exclude.description: Post-content criteria for rejecting a collected post: unwanted topics, post types, or meanings specified by the user. For example, exclude recruiting posts only when the user wants those excluded. Do not put source selection, Engager capture instructions, audience qualifications, or downstream outreach actions here. If no content exclusions were requested, omit or leave empty; do not invent exclusions.

filterMode.description: Whether to score posts against Include/Exclude (default) or bypass content scoring and keep every collected post. Bypass preserves criteria for later. Tags and Engager rules remain independent.

tags.description: Optional columns an AI fills for every post it keeps. Supply only when the user explicitly requested classification or tagging; never create Category, Sentiment, or any other tag by default. Each tag costs a model call per post.

options.description: The full vocabulary this column may hold. A tag is always an enum; leaving the values open lets the classifier invent a new one per post, which makes the column useless for filtering.

prompt.description: How to choose between the options for one post. Name the signal that decides each value rather than restating the option names.

replyDefaults.description: Complete shared Tone and Context for every reply strategy. Keep strategy-specific instructions in reply or replyStrategies.

tone.description: Shared voice and manner for every reply strategy.

context.description: Shared brand, product, or audience background every reply strategy may use.

reply.description: Optional all-posts strategy-specific instructions. Shared Tone and Context belong in replyDefaults. Set fields only from context the user supplied or from a specific social profile and recent posts/replies the user asked you to inspect.

goal.description: What a useful reply should accomplish.

claimsToAvoid.description: Claims, promises, or topics the reply must avoid.

productMention.description: How and when the reply may mention the product.

nextStep.description: The next action the reply should invite, when appropriate.

replyStrategies.description: Complete optional strategy set. Use this instead of reply when the user wants conditional or multiple strategies. Conditions reference tags from this same call. Different strategies must be mutually exclusive; [] intentionally generates no drafts.

id.description: Existing strategy id returned by get_listening. Omit only for a new strategy.

enabled.description: Whether this strategy generates drafts. Defaults to true.

conditions.description: Tag groups that route posts to this strategy. Leave empty only for one all-posts strategy; an all-posts strategy cannot coexist with another strategy.

fieldKey.description: Listening tag key from get_listening. During create_listening, the matching tag name is also accepted.

values.description: Any selected value inside this tag group may match. Different tag groups must all match.

replyAccounts.description: Optional per-platform account overrides. Omitted platforms inherit the Listening defaults. This does not authorize sending.

threads.description: Threads account id returned by list_listening_reply_accounts.

linkedin.description: LinkedIn account id returned by list_listening_reply_accounts.

x.description: X account id returned by list_listening_reply_accounts.

goal.description: What a useful reply should accomplish.

claimsToAvoid.description: Claims, promises, or topics the reply must avoid.

productMention.description: How and when the reply may mention the product.

nextStep.description: The next action the reply should invite, when appropriate.

instructions.description: Strategy-specific reply goal, guardrails, product mention, and next step. Shared tone and context belong in replyDefaults.

projectId.description: Project that owns this Listening and its durable context.

name: update_listening
title: Update Listening
description: Update an authorized Listening after get_listening. Complete-set fields replace their saved set, stale revisions fail closed, and account selection never authorizes a public reply.

listeningVolume.description: Explicit daily delivery settings shared by all sources in this Listening: newly retained Posts and newly delivered canonical Engagers. Uses UTC days. These are quantity settings, not provider capacity, guaranteed yield or a monetary cap. Set Posts and Engagers independently: supply at least one value, only with values the user chose. For Posts, 0 explicitly removes the daily limit. Updates merge supplied values and preserve an omitted sibling. Omit the entire policy to preserve saved limits or legacy absence. No automatic defaults.

maxPostsPerDay.description: Maximum new retained Posts per UTC day. Set 0 to remove the daily Posts limit; omit to preserve the existing setting.

maxEngagersPerDay.description: Maximum unique new people delivered to a List per UTC day for this Listening; omitted preserves its existing cap.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Required revision returned as updatedAt by get_listening. Stale revisions are rejected before any complete-set replacement.

name.description: New Listening name; omit to preserve it.

signals.description: Complete desired Signal set keyed by endpointId. Omit to preserve it; [] pauses every Signal.

endpointId.description: Exact Listening source type. A platform can have multiple Signals, such as x-post-search and x-user-posts.

inputs.description: Complete inputs for this Signal: search phrases for keyword sources, or account/profile/calendar identifiers for tracked sources. LinkedIn supports at most 5. For keyword sources, write short phrases people actually post, not ad keywords or a long concatenation of location and intent. Use the user's language and platform vocabulary. Keep account/profile identifiers unchanged for tracked-account sources. Keyword and tracked-account sources can coexist on the same platform: their results are combined, not intersected. A tracked account's posts do not implicitly have to match the keyword source. Use the Listening's Include/Exclude criteria when the user wants a content condition applied to every source.

schedule.description: Hourly, every 6 or 12 hours, or daily collection. New LinkedIn person/company sources default daily; LinkedIn keywords default every 12 hours; other sources default every 6 hours. Omit on update to preserve the saved schedule.

enabled.description: Whether this Signal collects now. New Signals default off. Paid Signals remain off until activate_listening is approved.

placeId.description: Required only for luma-event-search; the Luma location id.

platforms.description: Legacy social keyword format. Use signals for new calls; do not combine both fields.

keywords.description: Complete keyword set for this platform.

schedule.description: Hourly, every 6 hours, or daily collection.

enabled.description: Whether this platform Signal collects now.

include.description: Complete post-content criteria: what a collected post must discuss, describe, or demonstrate to be kept. For an already-selected account, describe which of its posts the user wants to see, not who to monitor. Source identity/schedule belong in signals; commenter/reactor/reposter capture belongs in Engager rules; downstream outreach and reply goals are not content filters. Do not infer buying intent or invent topical restrictions from those goals. If the user wants every post, set filterMode=bypass and preserve the existing criteria. null clears it; omit to preserve it.

exclude.description: Complete post-content criteria for rejecting posts: only unwanted topics, post types, or meanings specified by the user. Do not include source selection, Engager capture instructions, audience qualifications, or downstream outreach actions. Do not invent exclusions. null clears existing exclusions when the user requests that; omit to preserve them.

filterMode.description: Whether to score posts against Include/Exclude or bypass content scoring and keep every collected post. Omit to preserve the mode. Editing criteria alone never leaves bypass mode, and bypass preserves criteria for later. Tags and Engager rules remain independent.

tags.description: Complete desired tag set. Omit to preserve it; [] removes every editable tag.

key.description: Preserve the key returned by get_listening when editing an existing tag.

options.description: Complete allowed vocabulary for this tag.

prompt.description: How AI chooses among this tag's values.

replyAccounts.description: Patch default public reply accounts by platform (threads, linkedin, x). Use accountId from list_listening_reply_accounts. Omit platform keys to preserve; null clears a default. This does not authorize sending.

threads.description: Ready connected Threads account id to reply as by default. null clears it.

linkedin.description: Ready connected LinkedIn account id to reply as by default. null clears it.

x.description: Ready connected X account id to reply as by default. null clears it.

replyDefaults.description: Complete shared Tone and Context from get_listening. Omit to preserve both; use an empty string to clear one field.

tone.description: Shared voice and manner for every reply strategy.

context.description: Shared brand, product, or audience background every reply strategy may use.

replyStrategies.description: Complete desired strategy set. Preserve ids returned by get_listening for existing strategies; omit an id for a new one. Conditions use saved tag keys, selected values inside one tag are OR, and different tag groups are AND. Overlapping strategies and an all-posts strategy beside another strategy are rejected. [] removes every strategy and stops automatic draft generation.

id.description: Existing strategy id returned by get_listening. Omit only for a new strategy.

enabled.description: Whether this strategy generates drafts. Defaults to true.

conditions.description: Tag groups that route posts to this strategy. Leave empty only for one all-posts strategy; an all-posts strategy cannot coexist with another strategy.

fieldKey.description: Listening tag key from get_listening. During create_listening, the matching tag name is also accepted.

values.description: Any selected value inside this tag group may match. Different tag groups must all match.

replyAccounts.description: Optional per-platform account overrides. Omitted platforms inherit the Listening defaults. This does not authorize sending.

threads.description: Threads account id returned by list_listening_reply_accounts.

linkedin.description: LinkedIn account id returned by list_listening_reply_accounts.

x.description: X account id returned by list_listening_reply_accounts.

goal.description: What a useful reply should accomplish.

claimsToAvoid.description: Claims, promises, or topics the reply must avoid.

productMention.description: How and when the reply may mention the product.

nextStep.description: The next action the reply should invite, when appropriate.

instructions.description: Strategy-specific reply goal, guardrails, product mention, and next step. Shared tone and context belong in replyDefaults.

reply.description: Legacy all-posts strategy-specific fields to change. Shared Tone and Context belong in replyDefaults. Omitted fields stay unchanged, null fields clear individually, and reply: null clears the entire strategy.

goal.description: What a useful reply should accomplish.

claimsToAvoid.description: Claims, promises, or topics the reply must avoid.

productMention.description: How and when the reply may mention the product.

nextStep.description: The next action the reply should invite, when appropriate.

replyPrompt.description: Legacy unstructured reply instructions. Use reply for new calls.

name: delete_listening
title: Delete Listening
description: Delete one authorized Listening after exact one-time approval. Its collected Table remains available as an ordinary File.

approvalRequestId.description: Approved one-time SignalSurf action request. Omit on the first call; after approval, repeat the same call with this id.

name: list_listening_posts
title: List Listening Posts
description: Read bounded posts and activity totals collected by one authorized Listening. Filter by platform, publication time, text, or saved tags without discovering or reading an implementation Table.

listeningId.description: Listening id returned by Listening discovery.

includeActivityTotals.description: Include all-time keyword and reply totals for this Listening, independent of these filters. Bounded to 5,000 collected posts; omit for a normal paginated post query.

platform.description: Only posts collected from this platform.

publishedAfter.description: Inclusive earliest publication instant, ISO 8601 with timezone.

publishedBefore.description: Inclusive latest publication instant, ISO 8601 with timezone.

search.description: Case-insensitive literal text within collected post content.

tags.description: Exact tag filters combined with AND.

key.description: Exact enum tag key from the Listening configuration.

value.description: One allowed option from that tag.

limit.description: Maximum posts returned on this page.

name: get_listening_post
title: Get Listening Post
description: Read one authorized Listening post, its saved draft and reply history. This public read never refreshes provider metrics and never posts.

listeningId.description: Listening id returned by Listening discovery.

postId.description: Collected post id returned by this Listening query.

name: import_listening_post
title: Import Listening Post
description: Import one explicitly selected LinkedIn post URL into an authorized Listening after exact one-time approval. This reads provider metadata once and never creates a recurring watcher.

postUrl.description: An explicit https LinkedIn /posts/ or /feed/update/ link. Any publication age is accepted; the saved Listening filter still applies.

approvalRequestId.description: Approved one-time SignalSurf action request. Omit on the first call; after approval, repeat the same call with this id.

name: list_listening_reply_accounts
title: List Listening Reply Accounts
description: Read authoritative workspace social-account readiness for Threads, LinkedIn, or X, plus a Listening's saved defaults. A failed or unavailable read is unknown—not disconnected—and must not be guessed.

listeningId.description: Listening id returned by Listening discovery.

platform.description: Exact selected platform to check before Listening creation.

name: draft_listening_reply
title: Draft Listening Reply
description: Generate and save shared drafts for one post or one bounded page of authorized Listening posts. Drafting never publishes a reply.

listeningId.description: Listening id returned by Listening discovery.

postId.description: One collected post id. Prefer posts for two or more drafts; this legacy field is mutually exclusive with posts.

strategyId.description: Optional enabled strategy id from get_listening. This explicitly overrides automatic tag routing for this draft; omit it to route by the post's saved tags.

accountId.description: Optional connected reply account for this draft. When omitted, the matching strategy override or Listening default is saved when available.

instruction.description: Optional draft direction in addition to the saved Listening reply style.

posts.description: Up to one 50-post result page to prepare in one operation. Each may independently choose a strategy, reply account, and draft direction.

postId.description: Collected post id returned by this Listening query.

strategyId.description: Optional enabled strategy id from get_listening. This explicitly overrides automatic tag routing for this draft; omit it to route by the post's saved tags.

accountId.description: Optional connected reply account for this draft. When omitted, the matching strategy override or Listening default is saved when available.

instruction.description: Optional draft direction in addition to the saved Listening reply style.

name: send_listening_reply
title: Send Listening Reply
description: Publish one exact reply to an authorized Threads or LinkedIn Listening post. The first call prepares a one-time SignalSurf approval bound to target, sender, and body; after Web approval, repeat the same call with approvalRequestId. Ambiguous outcomes are never blindly retried.

listeningId.description: Listening id returned by Listening discovery.

postId.description: Collected post id returned by this Listening query.

accountId.description: Optional explicit reply account. Omit to use the Listening default for the target platform, or its sole ready account. Multiple accounts without a default require a choice.

body.description: Exact public reply text chosen by the user; the platform limit is checked before approval.

approvalRequestId.description: Approved one-time SignalSurf action request. Omit on the first call; after approval, repeat the same call with this id.

name: activate_listening
title: Activate Listening
description: Activate an authorized Listening's saved paid recurring collection scope. The first call prepares a one-time SignalSurf approval bound to current inputs, schedule, and credit ceiling; after Web approval, repeat the same call with approvalRequestId.

listeningId.description: Listening id returned by Listening discovery.

resumeSignals.description: Paused free endpoint ids to resume after approval, read from get_listening. Only the listed free ids are accepted; paid sources are never named here.

resumePlatforms.description: Legacy keyword-only shortcut. Use resumeSignals for new calls.

approvalRequestId.description: Approved one-time SignalSurf action request. Omit on the first call; after approval, repeat the same call with this id.

name: manage_listening_audience_capture
title: Manage Listening Audience Capture
description: Inspect or manage the Listening's Engagers capture rule and destination People List. Enabling recurring capture and deleting a rule prepare exact one-time approvals bound to the current saved state.

listeningId.description: Listening id returned by Listening discovery.

ruleId.description: Existing capture rule id; required for update, delete, and sync.

destinationListId.description: Product-owned People List that receives matched engagers. Omit on create to make a new List automatically.

destinationListName.description: Name a new People List to create when this configuration is saved. On update, replaces the destination without deleting the previous List. Do not combine with destinationListId. Omit to preserve existing destination behavior.

enabled.description: Whether scheduled capture is active for this rule.

channels.description: New rules must use LinkedIn only. Omit on create for LinkedIn; omit on update to preserve the existing platform scope.

tagFilters.description: Exact tag filters applied after the platform filter. Omit for all tags.

fieldKey.description: Exact Listening tag field key from get_listening.

values.description: Accepted exact values for this tag. Values are ORed within one tag; separate tag filters are ANDed.

qualificationRevision.description: Current destination List qualification revision from get_list_qualification; required when replacing an existing rubric.

qualification.description: Editable ICP qualification criteria for people after they enter the List. Prefill from the workspace ICP returned by get_listening, then refine for the destination List, shared by all of its Listenings. This is a saved snapshot, not a post filter; blank criteria skips scoring and retains all people. Omit on update to preserve.

enabled.description: Whether ICP scoring is enabled; omitted means enabled. Disabling preserves criteria and existing scores.

criteria.description: Saved audience criteria for assessing collected people; an empty string disables scoring.

source.description: Whether the saved criteria were imported from the workspace or customized for this List.

workspaceMemoryId.description: Canonical workspace ICP memory ID when these criteria were imported.

workspaceMemoryVersion.description: Version of the workspace ICP at import time; later workspace edits do not change the saved criteria.

collectionPolicy.description: Omit on create for connected LinkedIn with automatic basic profile details and a 2000-credit monthly safety ceiling. Daily profile attempts follow the Listening maximum new Engagers per day. The returned confirmation must be accepted before activation. Omit on update to preserve the saved policy.

version.description: Use version 3 for connected LinkedIn collection.

mode.description: Collect each LinkedIn post once without waiting for post maturity.

paidReposts.description: Explicit approval for paid repost capture; comments and reactions stay connected-only.

enabled.description: Enable profile details for delivered Engagers. Paid attempts share listeningVolume.maxEngagersPerDay; no configured quantity means no paid attempts.

monthlyCreditLimit.description: Internal UTC-month credit safety ceiling; reserved worst-case reads count, including failed attempts.

interactionTypes.description: Engagement types to capture. New connected LinkedIn rules default to comments; reactions are opt-in and reposts require a separate paid policy. Omit on update to preserve existing interactions.

refreshMinutes.description: Scheduled refresh interval in minutes, from 30 to 10080.

approvedMaxCredits.description: Exact server-computed ceiling copied from the approved confirmation. Do not invent this value.

approvalRequestId.description: Approved one-time SignalSurf action request when this change enables recurring provider collection. Omit for reads and non-external changes.
